echo "****************************************" echo "Adjusting server.env"
cd ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} mv ./server.env ./server.env.original if [ $? -gt 0 ]; then echo "ERROR: Original server.env not found, make sure you executed base setup"; exit "8"; fi
sedstring="s#^[ \#]*EKMF_API_DB_NAME=.*#EKMF_API_DB_NAME=${instance-DB_LOCATION}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA=.*#DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA=${instance-DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*DB_LIBPATH=.*#DB_LIBPATH=${instance-DB_LIBPATH}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*DB_CLASSPATH=.*#DB_CLASSPATH=${instance-DB_CLASSPATH}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*MSDKE_RABBIT_URI=.*#MSDKE_RABBIT_URI=${instance-MSDKE_RABBIT_URI}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*MSDKE_RABBIT_VIRTUAL_HOST=.*#MSDKE_RABBIT_VIRTUAL_HOST=${instance-MSDKE_RABBIT_VIRTUAL_HOST}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*MSDKE_EC_IDENTITY_KEY_LABEL=.*#MSDKE_EC_IDENTITY_KEY_LABEL=${instance-MSDKE_EC_IDENTITY_KEY_LABEL}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*MSDKE_WRAPPING_KEK_LABEL=.*#MSDKE_WRAPPING_KEK_LABEL=${instance-MSDKE_WRAPPING_KEK_LABEL}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*MSDKE_RABBIT_ENABLE_CERT_AUTHENTICATION=.*#MSDKE_RABBIT_ENABLE_CERT_AUTHENTICATION=true#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*MSDKE_EC_TRUSTED_KEYS_X509_ENCODED=.*#MSDKE_EC_TRUSTED_KEYS_X509_ENCODED=${instance-MSDKE_EC_TRUSTED_KEYS_X509_ENCODED}#g" sed -e "$sedstring" ./server.env.original > ./server.env
if [ $? -gt 0 ]; then echo "error adjusting file, previous version restored." mv ./server.env.original ./server.env rm ./server.env.original exit "8"; else rm ./server.env.original echo "server.env adjusted" fi
echo "****************************************" echo "adjusting configDropins"
echo "linking msdke-crypto-service.xml into overrides folder" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/options/msdke-crypto-service.xml configDropins/overrides/msdke-crypto-service.xml echo "linking db2-zos-type2.xml into overrides folder" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/options/db2-zos-type2.xml configDropins/overrides/db2-zos-type2.xml
if [ -f ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/options/msdke-http-testing-service.xml ]; then echo "testing service msdke-http-testing-service.xml found, linking into overrides" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/options/msdke-http-testing-service.xml configDropins/overrides/msdke-http-testing-service.xml fi
echo "Finished setting up configDropins:" ls -al configDropins/overrides
#if(${instance-MSDKE_ENABLE_HTTP_SERVICE} && ${instance-MSDKE_ENABLE_HTTP_SERVICE} == "true") echo "linking msdke-http-service.xml into overrides folder" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/options/msdke-http-service.xml configDropins/overrides/msdke-http-service.xml #end

Configure server for Crypto Connect Configure server.env with optional database parameters and link required configDropins for Crypto Connect. Database configuration is optional - if DB parameters are provided, all four (DB_LOCATION, DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA, DB_LIBPATH, DB_CLASSPATH) must be set. $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_SERVER} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_SERVER}
"1"=="1" always true
Only execute for Crypto Connect configuration
Skip if no Crypto Connect configuration is required ${instance-CRYPTO_CONNECT_SUPPORT_REQUIRED} == "false" Skipped
Submit shell script to execute step 1 true
echo "****************************************" echo "Checking database configuration parameters"
# Check if database parameters are set DB_PARAMS_SET=0 if [ -n "${instance-DB_LOCATION}" ]; then DB_PARAMS_SET=$((DB_PARAMS_SET + 1)); fi if [ -n "${instance-DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA}" ]; then DB_PARAMS_SET=$((DB_PARAMS_SET + 1)); fi if [ -n "${instance-DB_LIBPATH}" ]; then DB_PARAMS_SET=$((DB_PARAMS_SET + 1)); fi if [ -n "${instance-DB_CLASSPATH}" ]; then DB_PARAMS_SET=$((DB_PARAMS_SET + 1)); fi
# Validate: either all 4 parameters are set or none if [ $DB_PARAMS_SET -ne 0 ] && [ $DB_PARAMS_SET -ne 4 ]; then echo "ERROR: Database configuration incomplete!" echo "If database integration is required, all four parameters must be set:" echo " - DB_LOCATION" echo " - DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA" echo " - DB_LIBPATH" echo " - DB_CLASSPATH" echo "Currently set: $DB_PARAMS_SET out of 4" exit "8" fi
CONFIGURE_DB2=false if [ $DB_PARAMS_SET -eq 4 ]; then echo "Database parameters detected - will configure DB2 integration" CONFIGURE_DB2=true else echo "No database parameters - configuring Crypto Connect without DB2 integration" fi
echo "****************************************" echo "Adjusting server.env for Crypto Connect"
cd ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}
if [ "$CONFIGURE_DB2" = true ]; then mv ./server.env ./server.env.original if [ $? -gt 0 ]; then echo "ERROR: Original server.env not found, make sure you executed base setup"; exit "8"; fi echo "Configuring database parameters in server.env" sedstring="s#^[ \#]*EKMF_API_DB_NAME=.*#EKMF_API_DB_NAME=${instance-DB_LOCATION}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA=.*#DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA=${instance-DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*DB_LIBPATH=.*#DB_LIBPATH=${instance-DB_LIBPATH}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*DB_CLASSPATH=.*#DB_CLASSPATH=${instance-DB_CLASSPATH}#g" sed -e "$sedstring" ./server.env.original > ./server.env if [ $? -gt 0 ]; then echo "error adjusting file, previous version restored." mv ./server.env.original ./server.env rm ./server.env.original exit "8"; else rm ./server.env.original echo "server.env adjusted" fi else echo "Skipping database configuration in server.env" fi
echo "****************************************" echo "Adjusting jvm.options for Crypto Connect"
if [ "$CONFIGURE_DB2" = true ]; then mv ./jvm.options ./jvm.options.original if [ $? -gt 0 ]; then echo "ERROR: Original jvm.options not found"; exit "8"; fi echo "Configuring -Ddb2.jcc.ssid in jvm.options" sed "s#^[ \#]*-Ddb2.jcc.ssid=.*#-Ddb2.jcc.ssid=${instance-DB_JCC_SSID}#g" ./jvm.options.original > ./jvm.options if [ $? -gt 0 ]; then echo "error adjusting jvm.options, previous version restored." mv ./jvm.options.original ./jvm.options rm ./jvm.options.original exit "8"; else rm ./jvm.options.original echo "jvm.options adjusted" fi else echo "Skipping jvm.options configuration (no database configuration)" fi
echo "****************************************" echo "adjusting configDropins"
# Check for crypto-connect-v2.xml first (new version), fall back to crypto-connect-core.xml if [ -f ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/options/crypto-connect-v2.xml ]; then echo "linking crypto-connect-v2.xml into overrides folder" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/options/crypto-connect-v2.xml configDropins/overrides/crypto-connect-v2.xml else echo "linking crypto-connect-core.xml into overrides folder" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/options/crypto-connect-core.xml configDropins/overrides/crypto-connect-core.xml fi
echo "linking open-id-provider.xml into overrides folder" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/options/open-id-provider.xml configDropins/overrides/open-id-provider.xml
if [ "$CONFIGURE_DB2" = true ]; then echo "linking db2-zos-type2.xml into overrides folder" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/options/db2-zos-type2.xml configDropins/overrides/db2-zos-type2.xml else echo "Skipping db2-zos-type2.xml (no database configuration)" fi
echo "Finished setting up configDropins:" ls -al configDropins/overrides
shell-JCL 2048
